title: Canvas Window Spacing Uniformity
description: Fix vertical spacing between left and right canvas windows to match horizontal spacing and canvas edge insets.
summary: Unified canvas window gutters with edge insets: ResizableHandle is orientation-aware and uses var(--spacing-double) for width/height; Mode splitters pass orientation; Canvas/HorizontalWindows/VerticalWindows use p-double and gap-double. Added vertical-split gutter test.
